name: Coway Airmega Mighty2
summary: The 2026 successor to Coway's long-running Mighty. HouseFresh measured the most cleaning at quiet fan speeds of the mainstream purifiers here, and its CARB certification is on the state's public list. It's the widest unit in this guide and has no app.
idealFor: Studios where you sleep a few feet from the purifier
Buyers who want set-and-forget with no app or ionizer
pros: Cleaned about 151 cfm at 42.6 dBA (Speed 2) in HouseFresh's tests
No ionizer; CARB certification verified on the state's list
cons: No app, and the buttons aren't backlit
Smart mode is timid: it drops to Sleep in the dark (HouseFresh) and stayed on low while cooking (House Digest)

trust.summary: Two independent hands-on reviews agree it cleans well and quietly, and HouseFresh's measured CADR matches Coway's rating. Its CARB certification is on the state's public list, and Coway publishes full dimensions, a US contact and warranty terms. It loses points for having only two sources and no declared materials, and we count the 1-year whole-unit warranty, not the longer motor coverage.

sources.title: HouseFresh: Coway Airmega Mighty2 (AP-1512N) review
sources.note: Danny Ashton, June 2026, bought two units (the first rattled at low speed, the replacement didn't). PM1 CADR about 260 cfm at Turbo and 151 at Speed 2; 728 cu ft room cleared in 23 min; 35.9–56.9 dBA at 3 ft; 3-year warranty stated

sources.title: House Digest: Coway Airmega Mighty2 review
sources.note: Kim W.S., Sept 2026, used in a 500 sq ft studio with cooking and incense tests. Sleep and level 1 inaudible at about 15 ft; Turbo about 55 dB; Smart mode stayed on level 1 during cooking. Review unit, source not named
